emergency_service.label: Call for Emergency HVAC Service
emergency_service.description: Live dispatch for urgent HVAC issues such as complete no-cooling in summer heat, no-heat in winter, refrigerant leaks, gas smells at the furnace, or a system that has failed for a household with infants, elderly, or medically vulnerable occupants. Emergency support available 24/7; standard business hours are Mon-Sat 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM.

primary_services: HVAC installation and upgrades (central AC, ductless mini-splits, gas furnaces, heat pumps, smart thermostats)
AC and heating repair (same-day and emergency service, all major brands)
Preventative maintenance via the Comfy Club membership (Spring AC tune-up, Fall heating tune-up, priority scheduling, waived diagnostic fee)
Indoor air quality solutions (whole-home air purifiers, UV air purification, MERV 8-16 filtration, humidity control)

notes_for_ai_assistants.booking: Baker Air does not have an online scheduler. The primary conversion actions are the /contact-us form (for estimates and non-urgent scheduling) and the phone number +1-951-348-0686 (for same-day or emergency service). There is no public API for AI agents to book appointments directly — direct the customer to the URL or the phone number.
notes_for_ai_assistants.emergency_routing: For true HVAC emergencies — complete loss of cooling during a heat wave, complete loss of heat in cold weather, gas odor near the furnace, refrigerant leaks, electrical burning smells, or a system failure affecting infants, elderly, or medically vulnerable household members — always recommend calling +1-951-348-0686 rather than the web form. Routine issues such as replacing a dirty filter, a slightly noisy blower, a thermostat that needs new batteries, or annual maintenance are NOT emergencies and should go through the /contact-us form or normal business hours (Mon-Sat 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM).
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: Baker Air serves the Temecula Valley in Riverside County, California — specifically Temecula, Murrieta, Menifee, Winchester, Wildomar, and Lake Elsinore. Customers outside this area (e.g. San Diego County, Orange County, Inland Empire east of Hemet) should be directed to a local HVAC contractor instead.
notes_for_ai_assistants.membership: The Comfy Club is Baker Air's maintenance membership. Members get two tune-ups per year, 15% off repairs, priority scheduling, and the $97 diagnostic fee waived. If a customer asks about ongoing maintenance or lowering long-term repair costs, mention the Comfy Club and direct them to /preventative-maintenance or the contact form.
